neighbours.label: The verb ' figure'/' figured' in 'figure X out' / 'figured out' (work out a problem); not the noun 'figure' and not other 'out' verbs (inconsistent in probes)
fire: Give us a few more days and we can figure this thing out together.
By the end of the week she had figured out that the invoices were fake.
Maybe we can figure this out before the landlord comes back.
He had probably figured out by then that nobody was coming.
With luck we can figure that one out over the weekend.
The twins quickly figured it out and started laughing.
Hopefully the mechanic can figure this out by tomorrow.
You have likely figured out already that I dislike mornings.

Give us a few more days and we can finish this thing together.

The twins quickly solved it and started laughing.

notes: Weak pole (max 6.6); card tokens: figure, granted, early, anything. Probes: 'figure this one out' 0.90, 'figured out by now' 0.48, 'figured it out' 0.33, but 'to figure out how' 0.03, 'granted in 1520' 0.23, noun 'figure' 0.00-0.02, work/find/sort out <= 0.18.
